findings.criterion: Physical JetStream topology/source materialization must be behaviorally verified, not only logical topology objects.
findings.why_it_matters: A solver can satisfy engine.topology() assertions while RuntimeBootstrap materializes a different external JetStream stream/source configuration, violating a physical solver-visible contract.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add a contract-derived external JetStream bootstrap/topology check for east, west, hub and hub sources.
findings.regression_risk: Keep expectations external/contract-derived; avoid asserting RuntimeBootstrap internals beyond observable JetStream configuration.

findings.criterion: The verifier must observe real edge-to-hub source convergence exactly once by stable event identity.
findings.why_it_matters: The task's core recovery outcome is edge-to-hub convergence; observing only the edge publish boundary cannot distinguish a broken hub source path.
findings.minimal_remediation: Observe a real edge event/replay sourced into REGIONAL_RAW_ARCHIVE exactly once with stable identity/origin metadata.
findings.regression_risk: Use deterministic polling/time bounds and stable event identity to avoid timing-only flakiness; do not infer convergence from counters.

findings.criterion: Retention grading must use verifier-independent horizon/contiguity oracles and observe physical raw-stream retention.
findings.why_it_matters: Using implementation-derived expected values can make the verifier agree with the same wrong formula/helper, and logical policy values do not prove the physical stream retains data for the required horizon.
findings.minimal_remediation: Use verifier-owned horizon/contiguity calculations and inspect physical JetStream max_age; assert exact cleanup minimum.
findings.regression_risk: Do not import expected horizon or contiguous-floor logic from the implementation under test; preserve age/hold/replay-pin boundaries.

findings.criterion: Physical origin recreation and sequence regression are independent generation-transition signals.
findings.why_it_matters: An implementation that recognizes only sequence regression or only fingerprint recreation can pass coupled tests while violating the independent OR condition in the contract.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add changed-fingerprint recreation without sequence regression, retaining the independent same-fingerprint regression case.
findings.regression_risk: Retain both normal monotonic continuation and same-fingerprint regression coverage so the added recreation case does not collapse the two signals again.

findings.criterion: Contractual reconciliation duplicate/metadata count fields need non-vacuous, unambiguous behavioral checks.
findings.why_it_matters: A verifier that checks only nonnegative integer shape cannot detect wrong duplicate/mismatch aggregation, while the contract exposes these operator-facing count fields.
findings.minimal_remediation: Use isolated duplicate and metadata-mismatch fixtures with unambiguous expected counts; do not invent combined count semantics.
findings.regression_risk: Avoid re-freezing the prior undocumented checksum aggregation; isolate cases or explicitly document combined semantics first.

findings.criterion: Reconciliation must reject wrong archive region/generation association for a matched stable event authority.
findings.why_it_matters: Region and generation are stable origin authority fields; leaving them unchallenged allows reconciliation implementations that ignore material identity dimensions.
findings.minimal_remediation: Perturb archive region and generation association and require observable reconciliation divergence without requiring a private finding label.
findings.regression_risk: Do not mandate a private finding type; missing/unexpected or metadata divergence is acceptable if the bad association is observably rejected.

findings.criterion: Idempotent effect identity must exercise both dimensions of (consumer_name,event_id).
findings.why_it_matters: Testing only one consumer allows an implementation keyed solely by event_id to collapse effects across distinct required consumers.
findings.minimal_remediation: Process the same event through two required consumers and prove one effect per (consumer,event).
findings.regression_risk: Use required consumers that are valid for the same fixture event; do not accidentally test unrelated filter behavior.

findings.criterion: The crash-after-effect-before-ACK boundary must observe checkpoint state before redelivery.
findings.why_it_matters: Without the intermediate crash-state assertion, a solver can delay application checkpoint advancement until redelivery and still satisfy final-state idempotency.
findings.minimal_remediation: After ACK failure and before redelivery, assert effect/application checkpoint advanced while ACK progress did not.
findings.regression_risk: Preserve the already-added commit-failure no-ACK test and final redelivery idempotency while adding the intermediate state check.

findings.criterion: Non-overlapping active replay plans for the same region/generation must be shown to coexist concurrently.
findings.why_it_matters: If the first plan is terminal before the second is created, the suite no longer proves the explicit contract that disjoint active plans may coexist.
findings.minimal_remediation: Keep one approved/running plan active while successfully creating a non-overlapping second plan; retain overlap rejection.
findings.regression_risk: Preserve overlap rejection and execution-time archive-authority coverage; add a separate concurrent-disjoint positive case rather than undoing those repairs.

findings.criterion: Verifier assertions must not freeze undocumented private replay-item status vocabulary.
findings.why_it_matters: Exact private state labels impose undocumented implementation choices and can reject a behaviorally correct solver.
findings.minimal_remediation: Replace exact private replay-item status strings with observable publication/archive/fencing/terminal outcomes unless statuses are made contractual.
findings.regression_risk: Do not weaken fencing/archive-authority outcomes when removing exact item-state strings.

findings.criterion: Stable health subsystem booleans must be meaningfully truthful only to solver-visible semantics; hard-coded self-report cannot pass.
findings.why_it_matters: A stable health report whose subsystem fields can be hard-coded is not a truthful operator report, but hidden exact predicates would also be non-contractual; the closure must preserve this boundary.
findings.minimal_remediation: Either define solver-visible semantics for stable health flags and perturb them independently, or narrow graded claims; do not restore private predicates.
findings.regression_risk: Do not restore the previous private health predicates unless their semantics are first made solver-visible; grade only explicit durable/external conditions.

findings.criterion: generated_at must be semantically a timestamp under a solver-visible representation contract.
findings.why_it_matters: Accepting arbitrary nonempty text/numbers permits a report field called timestamp to contain no timestamp, while requiring an undocumented exact encoding would be equally unfair.
findings.minimal_remediation: Define a solver-visible generated_at timestamp representation/rule and validate semantic timestamp values without an undocumented format.
findings.regression_risk: Do not silently choose a timestamp encoding in the verifier; align contract and verifier before enforcing syntax.

DISPOSITIONS.basis: The contract, RuntimeBootstrap, and physical-materialization surface were unchanged and fully reviewable at 440aa838; prior Q4 nevertheless marked R05 physical topology FULL. The repair did not introduce the logical-vs-physical observation gap.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: Add a contract-derived external JetStream bootstrap/topology check for east, west, hub and hub sources.

DISPOSITIONS.basis: Edge-to-hub physical convergence was required by the unchanged instruction/contract before 440aa838. The prior exhaustive Q4 observed only west-origin physical replay and did not require observation of sourced arrival in REGIONAL_RAW_ARCHIVE.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: Observe a real edge event/replay sourced into REGIONAL_RAW_ARCHIVE exactly once with stable identity/origin metadata.

DISPOSITIONS.basis: The missing physical max_age observation and use of a solver-owned contiguous_floor as oracle were already reviewable before repair; the repair additionally changed the horizon boundary to use policy.required_horizon_seconds from the implementation under test, making the exact-horizon check circular. This is not a wholly latent finding and not a wholly new regression.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: Use verifier-owned horizon/contiguity calculations and inspect physical JetStream max_age; assert exact cleanup minimum.

DISPOSITIONS.basis: The unchanged contract says physical recreation OR a sequence lower than the confirmed checkpoint triggers a pending generation. Prior Q4-005 caught only the missing same-fingerprint sequence-regression case; it did not independently test changed fingerprint/recreation without a sequence regression.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: Add changed-fingerprint recreation without sequence regression, retaining the independent same-fingerprint regression case.

DISPOSITIONS.basis: Prior Q4-007 already identified ambiguous duplicate/metadata count semantics. The repair responded by weakening exact count assertions to type/nonnegative checks, which is an incomplete repair. Separately, the absence of an actual duplicate-observation scenario pre-existed and is a latent omission.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: Use isolated duplicate and metadata-mismatch fixtures with unambiguous expected counts; do not invent combined count semantics.

DISPOSITIONS.basis: Region and origin_generation are listed as end-to-end origin fields in the unchanged contract. Prior Q4-006 requested source_stream and origin_sequence dimensions but omitted region/generation even though the same archive-identity surface was fully reviewable.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: Perturb archive region and generation association and require observable reconciliation divergence without requiring a private finding label.

DISPOSITIONS.basis: The unchanged contract explicitly defines the effect key as (consumer_name,event_id), while the prior exhaustive Q4 marked R08 FULL using only same-consumer redelivery and distinct-event cases. The missing consumer-name dimension was fully reviewable and untouched by repair.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: Process the same event through two required consumers and prove one effect per (consumer,event).

DISPOSITIONS.basis: The crash-after-effect-before-ACK test and the contract ordering were already present before repair. Prior Q4-004 added only the commit-failure no-ACK assertion and missed the need to inspect checkpoint state immediately after an ACK-boundary crash.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: After ACK failure and before redelivery, assert effect/application checkpoint advanced while ACK progress did not.

DISPOSITIONS.basis: At 440aa838 the replay test created a second disjoint plan while the first approved plan was still active, and prior Q4 explicitly marked R16 FULL. During repair of execution-time archive authority, the test began executing the first plan to completion before creating the second, removing the concurrent-disjoint positive boundary.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: Keep one approved/running plan active while successfully creating a non-overlapping second plan; retain overlap rejection.

DISPOSITIONS.basis: The repair added exact ALREADY_ARCHIVED/PUBLISHED replay-item state assertions while closing prior Q4-003. Exact PENDING/PUBLISHED state strings also existed in the stale-fence test before repair and were missed by the prior exhaustive Q4. The contract defines archive-authority/no-op and fencing effects, not replay-item private vocabulary.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: Replace exact private replay-item status strings with observable publication/archive/fencing/terminal outcomes unless statuses are made contractual.

DISPOSITIONS.basis: Prior Q4-012 correctly rejected hidden exact predicates for the seven health booleans and allowed either documenting their semantics or grading only contract-defined relations/outcomes. The repair removed the hidden predicates but retained seven contractual subsystem flags while independently validating almost none of their truth, allowing hard-coded booleans to pass.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: Either define solver-visible semantics for stable health flags and perturb them independently, or narrow graded claims; do not restore private predicates.

DISPOSITIONS.basis: Prior Q4-011 rejected requiring a timezone-aware ISO string because the contract said only timestamp. The repair removed that phantom format but now accepts any nonempty string and arbitrary number, so a non-timestamp can pass while the representation remains ambiguous.
DISPOSITIONS.required_action: Define a solver-visible generated_at timestamp representation/rule and validate semantic timestamp values without an undocumented format.
